ordered_step_reconstruction: R7 gives a_i>0 and L_- with diagonal 1/a_i+1/a_(i+1)+K_i. INTERNAL-PHASE makes the sine numerator in K_i positive, while STRUCTURE gives sign(U_i U_(i+1))=(-1)^(i+1); hence K has n positive odd and n-1 negative even entries, all nonzero.
With D=diag(a_i) and path incidence B, L_-=K+B D^(-1)B^T and M=D+B^T K^(-1)B. Sylvester gives det(M)={det(D)/det(K)}det(L_-), hence sign det(M)=(-1)^(n-1)sign det(L_-).
Splitting odd and even rows gives M=P-C^T W^(-1)C with P>0, W>0 and H=C P^(-1)C^T-W. A second Sylvester/Schur identity gives sign det(M)=(-1)^(n-1)sign det(H).
The parity factors cancel, including when the determinants vanish, so sign det(L_-)=sign det(H). R7 then identifies det(H)>0 with det(L_-)>0, J<0 and partial_q A_n<0 without asserting that sign.
